joints.name: TopN
joints.code_transform: ftManagerMakeFighter: gcAddDObjForGObj; translate = world position (desc->pos), scale = attr.size (ftManagerInitFighter); ftMainSetStatus: rotate.y = lr * F_CLC_DTOR32(90) (value shown for lr=+1), rotate.x = rotate.z = 0

joints.name: TransN
joints.code_transform: ftMainUpdateHiddenPartID creates it when anim_desc bit 30 is set; ftMainSetStatus zeroes translate and rotate.z; root-motion joint (ftphysics reads its translate), detached from the hierarchy after the figatree is attached

joints.name: XRotN
joints.code_transform: ftMainUpdateHiddenPartID creates it when anim_desc bit 31 is set; ftMainSetStatus resets translate=0, rotate=0, scale=1

joints.name: YRotN
joints.code_transform: ftMainUpdateHiddenPartID creates it when anim_desc bit 29 is set; ftMainSetStatus resets translate=0, rotate=0, scale=1

joint_notes: Index = fp->joints[] index used by hitbox/hurtbox joint_id. 0 TopN (code), 1 TransN, 2 XRotN, 3 YRotN (created per motion by hidden parts), 4+i = DObjDesc[i] of commonparts[0].dobjdesc (lbCommonSetupFighterPartsDObjs is passed &fp->joints[4]). parent = tree parent in the base skeleton (no hidden parts); hidden-part joints use hiddenparts[].parent_joint_id + insert_kind (0 append last child, 1 first child, 2 second child, 3 insert between parent and its children). Rotations are radians; DObjDesc transforms are the bind pose that ftMainSetStatus restores on every status change before attaching the figatree.
commonparts_lo_notes: commonparts[1] (nFTPartsDetailLow) DObjDesc array, index i <-> joints[4+i]. joints[].translate/rotate/scale come from commonparts[0] (High). In Low detail (3-4 player battles) lbCommonSetupFighterPartsDObjs builds the tree from commonparts[detail_curr-1].dobjdesc ids and ftMainSetStatus restores the bind pose from it; DLs fall back to the High DL when the Low one is NULL.

shield_pose.format: animjoint32 (AObjEvent32 words: opcode = w>>25, flags = (w>>15)&0x3FF, payload = w&0x7FFF; values are raw f32 words), parsed by gcParseDObjAnimJoint
shield_pose.notes: anim_joints[angle_i][joint_num]: angle_i = guard stick angle / 45 (0..7), start frame = angle remainder in degrees (ftCommonGuardUpdateShieldAngle). ftCommonGuardInitJoints attaches the whole table with lbCommonAddDObjAnimJointAll(fp->joints[XRotN], table, angle_f), i.e. slot k drives slot_to_joint[k] (pre-order walk of the XRotN subtree); each animated joint is then blended toward dobj_lookup (joint 4.. use dobj_lookup[1..], YRotN the following entry) by the stick range. ftCommonGuardUpdateJoints re-attaches only table[joint_num] to YRotN, where joint_num = (#non-NULL joints[2..36]) - 1, and blends with dobj_lookup[joint_num]. ptr maps a word index of a pointer operand (Jump/SetAnim/SetInterp) to [stream, word_index]; no fighter shield stream contains such pointers in US v1.0.

hierarchy_notes: One entry per set of hidden parts enabled by some motion (key = hidden part indices). figatree_slot_order = joints visited by lbCommonAddFighterPartsFigatree (pre-order from joints[0]->child) = slot_to_joint; parent_at_figatree_attach = DObj tree right after the hidden-part pass of ftMainSetStatus; parent_during_motion = tree after the TransN detach at the end of ftMainSetStatus (TransN is then a leaf sibling whose animated translation is root motion). Index = joint index, value = parent joint index (-1 for TopN, null = joint absent). Computed for a status entered with no hidden parts present before; hidden parts are created in bit order.

anim_info.figatree16: u16 AObjEvent16: opcode = hw>>11, flags = (hw>>1)&0x3FF (track bits RotX,RotY,RotZ,TraI,TraX,TraY,TraZ,ScaX,ScaY,ScaZ), toggle = hw&1 (payload u16 follows); values are s16 scaled by ftAnimGetTargetValue
anim_info.slot_to_joint: figatree slot k drives fp->joints[slot_to_joint[k]] (lbCommonAddFighterPartsFigatree walks the DObj tree pre-order from joints[0]->child); depends on the hidden parts the motion enables, so motion_descs[].slot_to_joint is authoritative per motion
